caption: The drawing consists of three detailed illustrations of a single, irregularly shaped oyster shell that has rough textures and ridges. The shell is primarily rendered in shades of gray, black, and dark green, with touches of white and yellow for highlights, creating a textured and naturalistic appearance. The largest depiction dominates the center, showing the full face of the shell with deep grooves and a rough, fluted surface. In the upper left corner, a smaller, top-down view of the shell is presented within a square border, also showing the ridged texture and the circular opening at one end. In the lower right corner, a rectangular box contains a side view of the shell, where its curved profile and thickness are visible; a scale is provided indicating that 1/2 inch corresponds to 1 inch in the drawing. The composition is set on a plain, off-white background. The artist's name, Francis Law Durand, is printed in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Oyster Shaped Flask
